values.note: 2026 rates (May 1 - November 1): electric and water sites $38 Sunday-Thursday, $44 Friday-Saturday; electric, water and sewer sites $45 / $51; tent-only primitive sites $25 / $30. 15% off every night on stays of 7+ consecutive nights. Fees cover eight people from one household and two vehicles. Camper storage on a site $11/night (not Friday/Saturday). Cancellation more than 48 hours out costs $5/night (max $20).

values.note: 2026 rates are 'Effective May 1 through November 1' and 'The campground closes at noon on November 1 for the 2026 season.' Camping is available in season only.

values.note: 165-site campground (144 with electric and water, a limited number also with sewer) plus a separate tents-only section near the river. 'While we don't have paved pull-through sites, a lot of our sites are easy to maneuver into.' One axled camping unit per RV site.

sites.source: https://www.co.augusta.va.us/government/departments-and-offices/parks-recreation/parks-ballfields-trails-and-more/natural-chimneys/camping ('Natural Chimneys has a 165 site family-oriented campground with water and electrical hook-ups', FAQ 'Are there pull through sites?'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two bathhouses with hot showers; dump station free for registered campers only; small camp store and firewood at the Visitor Center. Pool is a separate charge.

facilities.source: https://www.co.augusta.va.us/government/departments-and-offices/parks-recreation/parks-ballfields-trails-and-more/natural-chimneys/camping ('Two shower-houses featuring hot showers', 'dumping facilities available for campers at no additional charge', 'The Visitor Center does have a small camp store'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on Augusta County's WebTrac site, in person or at 540-245-5753; paid in full when booked; reservations cannot be cancelled online. 'Advanced reservations are encouraged but walk-ups are welcomed if space is available.' 14 consecutive nights on RV sites (5 on tent sites), and 21 nights in any 30 days per household. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; late arrivals see the camp hosts on site F1.

summary: Confirmed on Augusta County's own camping page: 165 sites, 50-amp (and 30) electric with water, some sewer sites, showers, dump, reservable with walk-ups welcome. Added 2026 fees $38 (E/W weekday) to $51 (full hookup weekend), season May 1 - Nov 1, 14-night max, camp store, WebTrac booking link. Not stated: rig length (no paved pull-throughs).
